t.E412.agn: EFSA reported that data to demonstrate its safety in infant formulae and in foods for special medical purposes for infants are insufficient; for this reason the EU withdrew its authorisation in these products in 2026. It remains permitted in other foods.
t.E412.body: Guar gum is a soluble fibre; it is not absorbed and is fermented by bacteria in the large intestine.
t.E412.eff.1.t: Data to demonstrate its safety in infant formulae are insufficient; the EU withdrew its authorisation in these products in 2026
t.E412.prod: Obtained by physical means from plant seeds or tree exudate (gum).
t.E412.pw.0: In 2026 the EU withdrew the authorisation of guar gum in infant formulae and in foods for special medical purposes for infants.
t.E412.pw.1: In 2026 the EU withdrew the authorisation of guar gum in infant formulae and in foods for special medical purposes for infants.
t.E412.regx.0: Authorisation withdrawn in infant formulae and in foods for special medical purposes for infants (from 18.08.2026; transition until 27.04.2027 for one category).
t.E412.summary: A plant gum obtained from the seeds of the guar plant. It thickens ice cream, sauces and gluten-free products.
